title: Free trial period
body:
I downloaded this app a few days ago to try it out, and I deleted it on the first on September before the trial date ended as it wasn’t for me. It has now tried to charge me twice for a full yearly subscription the day after the cancellation and due to the unpaid charge I am unable to download apps on the App Store unless I pay for it. 

I deleted this app when I cancelled my subscription so I am currently unable to go to the help store hence I am now writing this on here. Please can I get some assistance with this?

title: So far so good
body:
Actually this should probably be a 5 star review.
I started with Strides not really knowing how much influence it may have on making my days more productive for good habits, and accountable for the bad ones. But it most certainly has brought more awareness, and a greater desire to make more of my days ‘green’ in all areas I put my attention too. 
Good work Strides. I’m impressed. 
Actually, yes.. 5 star for me.
